mechanism: Echinacea may induce CYP3A4 metabolism of sacubitril's active metabolite (sacubitrilat) and potentially increase immunostimulation in heart failure patients, while sacubitril may theoretically enhance echinacea's immunomodulatory effects.
action: Monitor blood pressure and clinical stability; advise patient to inform provider of echinacea use; consider alternative immune support given uncertain benefit in heart failure populations.
